help: `!help [command]` - Provides a specific explanation for any given command configuration.
commands: `!commands` - Displays the system directory manual grouping all utilities cleanly.
prefix: `!prefix [symbol]` - Alters the global command trigger prefix dynamically on the fly.
warn: `!warn @user [reason]` - Strikes the profile and dispatches a branded DM infraction card.
unwarn: `!unwarn @user [number]` - Removes a specified number of warning entries cleanly.
warns: `!warnings @user` - Audits a user profile's chronological strike files row-by-row.
clearwarns: `!clearwarns @user` - Wipes a user's infraction index cleanly back to zero strikes.
mute: `!mute @user [time] [reason]` - Restricts multi-channel chat access for a locked timeframe.
unmute: `!unmute @user` - Restores access rights immediately. Alerts if user is not muted.
kick: `!kick @user [reason]` - Pushes a server-branded DM layout card and kicks the account profile.
ban: `!ban @user [reason]` - Pushes a server-branded DM layout card and bans the profile permanently.
unban: `!unban [user_id]` - Strips permanent restriction data entries out of the ban ledger.
afk: `!afk [reason]` - Flags your account status as away. Calculates duration when you return.
nick: `!nick @user [name]` / `!n` - Updates a target member's nickname override instantly.
clearnick: `!clearnick @user` / `!cn` - Clears nick maps back to default user profile values.
serverinfo: `!serverinfo` - Generates a clean embed detailing server metrics along with its icon picture.
r: `!r add/give/remove @user [role]` - Modifies role structures using smart fuzzy keyword matching.
slowmode: `!slowmode [time]` - Engage text rate-limiting throttles on the active channel.
purge: `!purge [amount]` / `!c` / `!p` - Bulk deletes a specified block of text chat rows instantly.
pus: `!pus @user [no.]` - Target purges logs belonging *only* to a single selected user profile.
say: `!say [text]` - Broadcasts an anonymous message directly through the bot identity.
snipe: `!snipe` / `!s` - Recovers the content and author data parameters of the last deleted message.
cs: `!cs` - Flushes the channel message sniper memory log clean and reacts with a ✔️.
es: `!es` - Recovers the original text string state of recently edited chat messages.
ces: `!ces` - Flushes the edited message cache database completely and reacts with a ✔️.
ticket: `!ticket [category] [hex] [Title] | [Desc]` - Spawns a custom Tickety spawner panel.
closeticket: `!closeticket` / `!ct` - Locks, archives, and deletes an active help support ticket room.
